key.name: library-path
key.summary: Path to the user's Lists folder on disk
key.description: Empty defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/lists/Lists/. The user can relocate this to ~/Documents/Lists/ or any Syncthing/Nextcloud-managed folder via Settings.

key.name: default-list-id
key.summary: Default destination list for quick capture
key.description: The ULID of the list that receives a reminder when no list is specified. Defaults to the bundled Inbox sentinel id.

key.name: hide-completed-after-seconds
key.summary: Milliseconds before a completed reminder fades out of view
key.description: Controls the linger period after a reminder is marked complete. Range 0–10000 (0 = immediate; 10000 = ten seconds).

key.name: urgent-alarm-volume
key.summary: Audio loop volume for urgent alarms (0.0–1.0)
key.description: 0.0 silences the audio loop entirely; 1.0 plays at full output.
